tests: Fresh career starts on day 1 with safe defaults and six single-answer papers
All generated sums and visual counts have a valid, distinct wrong answer
Every curated question has a correct answer and three distinct false alternatives
Fair stamps pay coins, mistakes do not, and streak bonuses are bounded
A completed day settles and advances only once, including after reload
A mid-day reload preserves exact papers, marks and money without replaying awards
Thirty career days unlock all subjects, worksheets and classroom incidents
All five whole-worksheet grades correspond to four independent answer marks
Inspection expiry records one timeout, resets the next clock, and respects timer preference
Bell Rush uses elapsed seconds and cannot submit after the 60-second bell
Three mistakes end a marathon and every previous fair mark remains counted
Daily papers are deterministic for the date and differ on the next date
Answer-key assistance pays one coin and is excluded from all challenge records
Shop purchases deduct once, reject insufficient coins and enforce owned equipment
Save sanitisation bounds inputs, preserves zero reputation and drops unknown purchases
